Bill

I get the same error message when I back off to R version 3.6.3.  I have even tried to unzip the folder and load it that way without success.

Second, can you send the the code that worked for you?  I keep wondering if I doing something wrong.  Several colleagues, not rNOMADS users, have made suggestions like adding type=â€sourceâ€ but I keep hitting a brick wall.

If you are interested, Iâ€˜m trying to correlate low level winds from the Rapid Refresh Forecasts to longitude, latitude, and speed data from a phone ap that tracks hot air balloon flights.  Attached is a flight my wife made in Mesquite Nevada.  By changing altitude, color coded, she tracked back and forth across I-15 six times in an hour.  We joke that the FAA serial number on my father-in-lawâ€™s balloon was N-1132R.  And the R stands for ridicules.  We donâ€™t go anywhere...we really donâ€™t accomplish anything.  But itâ€™s kind of a Zen thing.  Controlling the balloon by finding the right wind is such a hoot.

Thanks,
Philip Heinrich
